name: polish-academic-skills
description: Standalone, dependency-free Agent Skills for Polish academic, scientific, legal, cultural and public data sources -- ported from polish-academic-mcp, no MCP server required.

plugins.name: polish-academic-repositories
plugins.description: Search and fetch metadata from Polish academic institutional repositories and open research-data repositories: Biblioteka Nauki, RCIN, RUJ, AGH, AMU, UAFM, ICM Open, RODBuK, and RePOD.

plugins.name: polish-science-bibliography
plugins.description: Query Polish science-bureaucracy and bibliography data: PBN (Polska Bibliografia Naukowa), POL-on/RAD-on institution datasets, and Ludzie Nauki researcher profiles.

plugins.name: polish-open-data-statistics
plugins.description: Search Polish government open data (dane.gov.pl) and official regional statistics from GUS's Bank Danych Lokalnych (BDL).

plugins.name: polish-weather-hydrology
plugins.description: Real-time Polish weather, hydrology, and warnings data from IMGW-PIB (danepubliczne.imgw.pl), no API key required.

plugins.name: polish-legal-normative-documents
plugins.description: Search Polish legal acts (ISAP/ELI), the Biblioteka Sejmowa parliamentary library catalog, court judgments (SAOS), and PKN technical standards.

plugins.name: polish-culture-archives
plugins.description: Query Polish cultural-heritage archives and catalogs: Baza Legalnych Zrodel, BazTOL, NAC (National Digital Archive), Katalog Biblioteki SUM (Aleph), PAUart, Wolne Lektury, and Dokumenty Slaska.

plugins.name: polish-film-heritage
plugins.description: Search Polish film and photography heritage archives: Ninateka, Gapla, Fototeka, FilmPolski.pl, Fototeka Slaska, and the FN digital repository.

plugins.name: polish-academic-skills-all
plugins.description: Bundle of all 7 polish-academic-skills: academic repositories, science bibliography, open data/statistics, weather/hydrology, legal/normative documents, culture archives, and film heritage.
